crossRefs.note: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings.

translations.web: for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’
translations.bsb: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment.’
translations.kjv: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
translations.asv: for I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.
